## Checklist

- [ ] No new network access, remote asset or weakened Content-Security-Policy
- [ ] Any new pixel, geometry or metadata loss is declared before conversion and measured after it
- [ ] Full suite passes locally (notices, typecheck, unit, browser, build, budget, e2e)
- [ ] New bundled dependencies are listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` with their licence text
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased" if users will notice the change
